purpose: Represent a single Cash point-balance truth by role, basis, point, account/location and Financial Truth scope without source-specific mapping or balance arithmetic.
observed_balance_rules: observed_proven=true is required for numeric observed balance.
Point date/timezone/timestamp, account, scope, source, as_of, reconciliation and lineage must be valid.
MOVEMENT_ONLY and CONTEXT_ONLY can never normalize to a numeric balance.
NOT_CONNECTED always remains value=null and quality=NOT_CONNECTED.
Explicit observed zero is valid when all evidence gates pass.
Payment-method metadata is not balance evidence.
computed_balance_rules: COMPUTED_BALANCE is allowed only for balance_role=OPENING in V1.
Numeric computed opening requires non-empty privacy-safe computation lineage.
Dependency GAP fails closed; explicit NOT_CONNECTED dependency remains NOT_CONNECTED.
Any ESTIMATE dependency caps output quality at ESTIMATE.
TASK-061 validates caller-provided computation proof and never calculates anchor plus movements.
point_rules: Financial Truth period is start=end=point.date using exact point.timezone.
point.timestamp must be a valid zoned timestamp representing point.date in point.timezone.
Caller-supplied targetPoint is validated exactly; helper never chooses a business opening/closing date or clock window.
OPENING must match the requested target start point/date.
OBSERVED_ENDING must match the requested target end point/date.
Current balance cannot be backdated to a historical target.
scope_rules: Financial Truth branch/channel scope remains explicit.
One branch/account is never silently promoted to enterprise ALL.
numeric_rules: Missing, NaN and Infinity fail closed.
Finite negative generic balance is allowed because account-specific overdraft/physical-cash policy is outside TASK-061.
-0 normalizes to 0 through Financial Truth V1.
reconciliation_rules: Numeric balance may use any canonical non-UNKNOWN Financial Truth reconciliation status supported by evidence.
TASK-061 does not require every observed point to be RECONCILED.
UNKNOWN reconciliation cannot carry a numeric value.
cash_bridge_compatibility: OPENING.truth is directly compatible with Cash Bridge openingBalance when target start date/timezone/scope match.
OBSERVED_ENDING.truth is directly compatible with Cash Bridge observedEndingBalance when target end date/timezone/scope match.
No Cash Bridge arithmetic is duplicated or modified by TASK-061.
